Introduction.SourceString: 前秘密组织「红字」的成员，代号「赤葵」，现为格赫罗斯岛囚犯。
Introduction.LocalizedString: A former member of the secret organization "The Scarlet Letter," code-named "Red Nightshade," now a prisoner on Ghroth Island.

Content.SourceString:
残虹鲜少提起她来到「红字」之前的经历，于她而言，那段幽暗的时光并不值得回顾。
一切起始于一场愚昧而隐秘的实验，孤身的少女被当做培育异能的「容器」，执行者与那些贪婪狂妄的权贵将她视作通往奇迹的牺牲品。灼痛、幽闭、毁伤、重塑……那些邪异骇人的摧残是她每日必经的考验。她无数次在生死的边缘挣扎，又无数次被拉回人间，随后进入下一次苦痛的轮回……
直到一个讽刺般的奇迹真的发生，她爆发异能，将那隐秘罪恶的地牢也化为一片腥红的废墟，除她以外，无一人生还。
一位高贵优雅的慈善家率先发现了废墟中的异能者少女，随后像移栽一朵野花一样，将她带回了自己的花园之中。令她欣喜的是，这枝生于血污、历经摧折的野花早已无比坚韧，正合她的心意。
于是，名为「赤葵」的花朵扎根于「红字」的土壤，伊南娜得到了她最为忠诚的养女，最为锋利的刀刃。
但伊南娜并不知晓，这位女儿并非其他人那样容易掌控。她对自己的异能缄口不言，只是在阴影中睁着那只能够洞察人心的异眼，窥探着她的新家人。那些试图欺压、讨好或甚至只是对她好奇的同辈，多在与她对视之中受到侵蚀，不自觉地陷入一片虚实难辨的泥淖，开始怀疑周遭是真是幻，甚至连这种怀疑都渐渐消散，最终变成对她言听计从的玩物……
「每个人心里都有一团火焰。」
在残虹的眼里，人们的面目都是无趣的灰白，但灵魂的红色却始终烧燎不息。
人与人的火焰各异，有的炽烈，有的黯淡，有的昏黑，有的猩红……于她所见，大都是些平庸至极的灵魂，偶有看得过眼的，也只能当作短暂的玩物。每当看着那些火焰在崩溃边缘燃尽、散发出一缕缕绝望的死灰时，她才会露出一点满足而愉悦的神情，仿佛终于欣赏到了一幅期待已久的杰作。
但在这冰冷单调、由无数无趣火焰点缀的世界里，却始终有一个灵魂是特殊的……起初，那是纯净的白色，后来，那都是她从未在别处见过的、一抹未名的异色。
「多漂亮的颜色啊……总是让我欲罢不能。」
Content.LocalizedString:
Zankou rarely speaks of the days that came before she joined The Scarlet Letter. To her, such dark times were not worth remembering.
It all began with a careless, secret experiment. A solitary, unknown girl was treated as a vessel for cultivating Esper Ability, and the researchers, along with those greedy, gluttonous elites, considered her a worthless sacrifice on the path to greatness. Unbelievable pain, solitude, mutilation, rebirth… these grotesque, repulsive torments were daily occurrences. Time and again, she would inch towards the edge of death, only to be dragged back to the world of the living.
Until, in a bitter irony, a miracle truly came to pass: her Esper Ability burst forth, turning that sinful dungeon into an ocean of blood. No one survived but her.
A noble, pure-hearted philanthropist was the first to discover her amidst the ruins. She brought that girl back to the gardens, as if transporting a feral wildflower. To her delight, that wildflower, born in the filth and muck, was already tempered completely—exactly to her liking.
Thus, the flower known as "Red Nightshade" took root in the soil of Scarlet Letter, and Inanna gained her loyal adopted daughter—her sharpest dagger.
Yet, Inanna was unaware that the "leash" on her daughter frayed at the edges. Zankou kept quiet about her own Esper Ability, and only opened that uncanny eye of hers from the shadows, hoping to peer into her new family's hearts. Those who tried to bully her, curry favor, or befriend, were merely ignored—and instead swept into a sinking mire, where reality and illusion blurred. They began to doubt what was real or false, slowly transforming into soulless husks—playthings to be puppeteered by Zankou.
"Everyone has a flame burning in their heart."
To Zankou, people's faces were merely monochrome, but the bright red flames of their souls never ceased to burn.
Each person's fire was different—some fierce, some dim, some dark, some crimson… In her eyes, most were utterly mundane; the few that were worth a second glance could only serve as brief playthings. It was only when she watched those flames burn themselves out on the brink of collapse, exhaling flake after flake of hopeless ash, that she showed a hint of delight, as if at last admiring a masterpiece.
But in this cold, monotonous world, dotted with countless dreary flickers, there was always one different soul… At first, it was a blinding white; later, it became a hue she had yet to see anywhere else—an indescribable color.
"How beautiful… I'm unable to look away."

Content.SourceString:
对于未知之物，人类总是有着相似的好奇与傲慢。从敬畏到恐惧，从试探到染指，直到名为「征服」的火种彻底点燃贪婪的引线……对于「异能」这一存在，一部分人的态度便是如此。
教派、学会，私人研究所，秘密结社……那些被贪婪与狂热所驱使的人，如同嗅到血腥的鬣狗般汇聚成群。他们不惜一切代价，无视一切限制与禁忌，渴求着异能所带来的奇迹……或者，渴求着异能本身。
在某座小岛上，存在着一个名为「琢目鸟」的秘密结社。成员们信奉着一种邪说——异能是神秘者的恩赐，而恩赐将降福于拥有着特殊眼瞳的幸运之子。于是，他们四处收集着适格者，将他们视作觉醒异能的「容器」，豢养于地牢之中，每日用烈性的秘药淋洗他们的眼睛。他们相信这样能激发异能，如果将其眼睛移植给自己，就能将异能据为己有。
残虹最初的记忆，就始于那个荒谬而残忍的地牢。
少女有一双宝石般漂亮的眼睛，初见她的人们都会与她对视，但她无法理解，因为缺失色觉的她只能看见一团灰白。她更不理解的，是贪欲和愚昧催使之下，人的恶行能到何种地步。自从「琢目鸟」为了这双眼睛将她掳走，她存在的全部意义，就是每日被拘束手脚，撑开眼睑，颤抖地注视着那滚烫刺鼻的浑浊液滴落入眼球，随后在钻心的剧痛之中，听取周遭的邪恶祷告。
啜饮贪婪的人们日复一日地践行着自己的假说，不顾其中荒谬。可讽刺的是，残虹真的在这非人的折磨之下，觉醒了寄宿于眼睛的异能。她被带到取眼仪式现场时，结社的成员们争吵着眼睛的归属，他们纷纷亮出自己隐藏的身份：权贵，富商，或是某个声名显赫的家族……声音渐渐嘈杂模糊，残虹在麻醉的迷蒙中，看见了黑白之外的第一种颜色，它温暖而夺目，从灵魂的火焰中迸射，从厮杀的伤口中喷溅，连成一片包围着她的猩红池沼……
那一天，「惑乱之眼」的幻境笼罩着整座小岛，彼此猜忌竞争的凶犯们在幻觉中自相残杀，直到无人生还。
Content.LocalizedString:
When it comes to the unknown, human beings have always shared the same curiosity and arrogance. From awe to fear, from scrutinizing to touching, until the spark of "conquest" fully ignited the fuse of greed… such was the attitude some held toward the existence known as "Espers".
Cults, circles, private research institutes, secret societies… those driven by greed and pride gathered like hyenas, desperate for a morsel of flesh. They would pay any price, ignore every restriction and taboo, and thirst for the miracles an Esper Ability could bring… or perhaps, for the ability itself.
On a remote island, there was a secret society deemed "Eyepecker." Its members believed in a heresy: Esper Abilities were a gift from a mysterious unknown, and that gift would bless the fortunate ones born with special "eyes". They went about collecting those who were described as such, regarding them as "vessels" for the awakening of Esper Abilities, imprisoning them in dark, dank dungeons and burning their eyes every day with a searing mixture. They firmly believed this would awaken abilities—and that by transplanting those eyes into themselves, they could seize that power for their own.
Zankou's earliest memory began in that cruel jail.
The girl had a pair of gem-like eyes. She could not understand why, her vision deprived of color, she could only see a gray-white blur. What she understood even less was how far a human's greed could push them to do the unspeakable. Ever since Eyepecker had abducted her, the meaning of her existence had been reduced to being completely bound every day, having her eyelids pried open, and trembling as the scalding, acrid, murky liquid dripped onto her eyeballs.
The voracious, intoxicated by their own delusions, carried out their devilish deeds day after day, heedless of its absurdity. Yet, ironically, Zankou really did awaken the Esper Ability dwelling in her eyes under that inhuman torture. When she was brought to the eye-extraction ritual, the society's members were already arguing over who the eyes would belong to, each one revealing the hidden identity they had been concealing all along: the powerful, the wealthy, or some illustrious family… Their voices grew into a raucous uproar, and in the haze of anesthesia, Zankou saw the first color beyond black and white. It was warm and blinding, burning brightly among the embers of countless souls, spraying from wounds opened in slaughter, weaving into a scarlet maelstrom that encircled her…
That day, the Eye of Delusion shrouded the entire island, and the lowlifes who competed with one another instead butchered each other to death, drowning within the hallucination, until no one was left alive.

Content.SourceString:
残虹在血泊当中看见了一抹惊悚而瑰丽的红色。
红色的主人朝她走来，高跟鞋的声音在空荡的地牢回荡。接着那声音停了下来，变成如丝绒般温柔的话语，试图包裹她仍惊惶不定的灵魂。
「让我看看你的样子，可怜的小花瓣儿。」
「从今天开始，红字就是你的家了。」
家……是什么？
面前的女人给了少女一个名为「家」的许诺，给了她温暖的怀抱、穿过头发的手指，少女并不明白她话语的用意，但她能感觉到，她的话语和触碰比任何人都要柔和。
「你可以称我为，母亲。」
残虹戒备地看向面前的瘦高女人，她温柔的眼眸之下，潜藏着一份发现财宝一般的贪婪笑意。她的灵魂之火如她的衣着一般猩红瑰丽，贪婪的火舌在少女眼前燎烧跃动，几乎要她吞入其中。
可是，她还是心甘情愿地喊出了那一声：
「母亲。」
Content.LocalizedString:
Zankou saw a shockingly pleasing red in the pool of blood.
The owner such red strut towards her, her high heels echoing throughout the empty dungeon's walls. Then the clacking stopped, giving way to velveteen words:
"Let me see your face, my poor little petal.
From today on, Scarlet Letter is your home."
Home… what was that?
The woman before her promised the girl something she couldn't comprehend: a "home." Though the girl couldn't understand the meaning of the woman's words, she could feel that her voice and touch were gentler than anything she had ever experienced.
"You may call me… Mother."
Zankou looked warily at the tall, thin woman before her. Beneath her gentle gaze lurked an indecipherable smile. The blaze of her soul was as vermilion and resplendent as the clothes she wore, and its greedy flames danced and flared before the girl's eyes, almost burning her alive.
Yet, she still willingly replied with one word only:
"Mother."

Content.SourceString:
红字的花园中养育着许多花朵，慈爱的伊南娜呵护着她们，为她们降下甘露，修剪枝条。其中最得她欢心的花朵，还会被她赐予新的名字——「赤葵」便是其中之一。
可残虹知道，母亲并不爱花，她只是享受置身于花园中心的感觉。
在红字的宅邸，伊南娜不再隐藏自己的本性。慷慨感性的慈善家只是她对外的表演，她的心中只有作为商人的冷漠与贪婪，外加一份跻身名流之后、那与日俱增的傲慢。她如同一座伟岸而猩红的高塔，在花园中投下惊悚的阴影。
伊南娜对待她的女儿们向来恩威并施，而对残虹的训练和体罚尤为严苛。但残虹并不在乎，地牢中的经历早已麻痹了她的痛觉。在经受折磨之后，她依然会向母亲献上忠心，完成母亲布置的每个任务。而当其他的姐妹们被母亲拿捏、玩弄命运之时，目睹这一切的残虹感觉到，自己也能在花园里找到一些乐子。
「惑乱之眼」可以洞悉情绪，也能品尝情绪。恐惧的腥甜，绝望的酸楚，仇恨的辛辣……姐妹们的情绪成为了滋养残虹的养料。残虹逐渐理解了母亲的爱好。
她的异眼始终寻觅着颜色最鲜艳的灵魂，如同欣赏与采撷鲜花。每当夜里，府邸响起动听的啜泣，灵魂的火苗颤动不已，残虹便会欣然前往，为那朵脆弱的花带去慰藉，随后将其掌控、玩味、抛弃，那些心神动荡的妹妹在她的话语和注视之下得到解救。
可是这样的快乐总是难能长久。女孩们的心智很快因注视「惑乱之眼」而磨损，沦为任残虹驱使的废人，灵魂的颜色也变得黯淡，如同花朵凋零，变得枯槁无趣。
但是没关系，「红字」的花园很大，纵然这朵鲜花凋谢，也总有下一朵鲜花。
Content.LocalizedString:
The Scarlet Letter Garden nurtured many flowers. The loving Inanna tended to them, raining down sweet dew and pruning their branches. The flowers that pleased her most were even granted new names—"Red Nightshade" was one of the many.
Yet, Zankou knew that Mother did not love her flowers; she simply enjoyed standing at the center of the garden and admiring her hard work.
Within the Scarlet Letter's estate walls, Inanna no longer needed to hide her true nature. The generous, sentimental philanthropist was merely a public performance. In the confines of her heart, there was only a businesswoman's austere coldness and greed, along with the arrogance that developed unceasingly once she had entered "high society". Like a towering crimson spire, she cast a chilling shadow, looming endlessly over her Garden.
She always mixed rewards with punishment when dealing with her daughters. Zankou was subjected to the harshest training. Zankou didn't care; her time in the dungeon had long since numbed her to pain. Even after enduring such torment at the hands of Mother, Zankou still dedicated complete loyalty to her, and carried out every task she was given. As she watched her other sisters have their emotions and fates toyed with, however, Zankou found that she, too, could find a little amusement in the Garden.
The Eye of Delusion could perceive emotions—and taste them, too. The rotten sweetness of fear, the bitterness of despair, and the sharp bite of hatred… her fellow flowers' feelings became nourishment for Zankou… And Zankou came to fully understand Mother's hobby.
Her aberrant eye was always on the prowl for vivid colors, as if admiring a field for its beautiful blooms, only to pluck the finest flowers. Whenever a lovely sobbing rang out through the estate at night, and the tiny glows of the soul twinkled, Zankou would gladly bring comfort to that fragile bud, then later control it, toy with it, to then ultimately cast it aside. Under her words and gaze, those unsettled little buds bloomed.
Such pleasure never lasted long. The girls' minds were rapidly frayed from gazing into the Eye of Delusion, becoming husks at Zankou's mercy, and the color of their souls faded, withering and unwatered.
It never mattered, though. The Scarlet Letter's Garden was vast; even if one blossom withered, there would always be another waiting to sprout.

Content.SourceString:
在所有的姐妹中，唯有一位，残虹在与之对视时，会克制住自己的异能。
也唯有这一位，拥有着她前所未见的灵魂。那是一团纯粹、透亮的苍白火焰，如同黎明破晓时的那一抹澄净。如同置身奇景一般，她在相遇的第一刻便脱口而出……
「多漂亮的颜色啊……」
但名为达芙蒂尔的白衣少女并不理解，她只是听从养母的命令，走向车门弯腰行礼，伸手迎接她的妹妹。
「欢迎回家，妹妹。」
残虹探出手，向她靠近，痴迷与好奇在她眼中凝聚，一副近乎狰狞的笑容在少女脸上浮现。她如同抢夺一般猛然抓紧了那只手，将姐姐向自己拉近，几乎要把自己投进那团洁白的火焰之中……
在这次略显意外的问候之后，她们奉命成为了搭档，姐妹，家人。
残虹知道，她与姐姐并非同类，可是那又如何？两个截然相反的同义词，同行就是她们的命运，「红字」的花园中缠绕着无数藤蔓，会把她们捆绑在一起，不死不休。她们会踏入同一片泥沼，分享同一片床榻，走向同一个战场，归于同一片坟茔。所以，她们就是最亲密无间的家人。
她日复一日地看着达芙蒂尔，用她那只特别的眼睛。作为最早被伊南娜领养的女儿，达芙蒂尔坚定而麻木，如同一块顽石，无论面对多么严苛的任务，都能毫不动摇地回应着母亲的期许，在清除目标时，更是冷静得如同一台机器……而这样的姐姐，却会在每次任务或责罚结束之后，温和地为她治愈伤口，但即便是温情的此刻，她也鲜少说话。
……但后来，不知出于什么原因，姐姐变了。那份下手时的果断和淡漠，变成了紧皱眉头的犹豫，以及与日俱增的、每夜都会小声倾诉的忧郁与困惑。从此，那团洁白而稳定火苗偶尔晃动、摇曳，而这一切都尽收于残虹的眼底。
「哦，原来她还有这样的一面。」
残虹继续注视着达芙蒂尔，仿佛注视一枚萌动的花苞。如果姐姐变得软弱了，她会在母亲摧毁和抛弃姐姐之前，把她变成自己最珍贵的收藏……她满怀遗憾地期待着那天。
Content.LocalizedString:
Among all her sisters, only one made Zankou limit her abilities when they locked eyes.
Her soul was a pure, translucent flame, as clear as the first light of dawn. As if beholding a wondrous sight, she blurted out at their very first meeting…
"What a beautiful color…"
But the white-clad girl named Daffodill didn't understand. She simply obeyed her adoptive mother's orders, walked to the car door, bowed, and reached out to welcome her new little sister.
"Welcome home, little sister."
Zankou reached out toward her, obsession and curiosity gathering in her eyes. Unknowingly, a feral smile nearly surfaced on the girl's face. As if snatching something away, she suddenly clutched that girl's hand tightly, pulling her closer, as if wanting to bathe herself in that hallowed flame…
After that unconventional greeting, they were eventually ordered to become partners, sisters—family.
Zankou knew she and her sister were not the same, but so what? Two complete opposites—conjoined in their fate. In the Scarlet Letter Garden, countless vines would wind around and bind them, till death did them part. They would step into the same mire, share the same flower bed, walk onto the same battlefield, and return to the same grave. They were as close as family could be.
Day after day, she watched Daffodill through her "special" eye. As the first daughter adopted by Inanna, Daffodill was steadfast and immovable, rigid—no matter how harsh the mission, she would always surpass Mother's expectations. When it came to eliminating a target, she was even unfeeling… Yet that very same sister would tenderly heal her wounds after every mission or punishment.
…But later, for some undiscernable reason, Daffodill changed. That decisiveness and indifference became hesitation, along with growing melancholy and confusion. From then on, that white, steady flame would occasionally flutter.
"So she has a side like that too, then."
Zankou continued to observe Daffodill, as though watching a bud begin to blossom. If her sister became weak, before Mother destroyed and discarded her, she would transform her into her most prized possession. With a heavy heart, Zankou looked forward to that day.

Content.SourceString:
「……后院的角落里，有一只兔子。」
「我拿菜叶喂了它，它都吃掉了，没有咬我……」
残虹听着达芙蒂尔说话，面带微笑，思绪却在心中绞缠起来。
她不理解兔子有什么好看的，长着一双红眼的灰色实验动物而已。她也不明白，区区一只兔子凭什么让姐姐露出那样……松懈的神情。
但之后的数月，只要到了去后院接受体罚的时候，达芙蒂尔就会偷偷看向那只兔子，而残虹看向她。即便是经受着痛苦，姐姐的眼神也会柔和许多。残虹偶尔也会想，也许这样柔软的眼神，是不会被母亲允许出现在她们眼中的。
直到某天，达芙蒂尔在熟悉的角落只看到了兔子的尸体。她沉默了一整天，还未入夜便把自己锁进了房门。
残虹敲了良久，那扇门才向她缓缓打开。姐姐空洞的目光垂在地上，灵魂如同风中阴燃的火苗一般，毫无凭依地颤动着。残虹的眼睛捕捉到一股酸楚的滋味，她从未在姐姐身上品味到如此清晰而动摇的情绪。
她试探地伸出手，将情绪低落的姐姐缓缓地拉近。她感觉到姐姐迟疑了一片刻，随后像是卸下了一切一般，毫无抵抗地将脸靠在了她的肩上。温度交叠的那一刻，残虹在心底发出一声满足的喟叹。她甚至庆幸于那只兔子的死亡。
「或许，当姐姐再想起那只兔子尸体的时候，一定会怀疑是我动的手吧。」
在姐姐叛逃后的许多个夜里，残虹常会想起那只死去的兔子。
但姐姐是不会问的，自己也不会去提，甚至，她也不知道何时能再与姐姐相遇。
但她并不感到遗憾。因为她知道，在故事的结尾，她和姐姐中的一人一定会死于另一人之手。在其中一人的弥留之际，将这个话题当作告别的话语或许不错。
「姐姐，我真的没有杀死那只兔子。」
Content.LocalizedString:
"…There's a rabbit in the corner of the backyard."
"I fed it some cabbage leaves. It ate them all, and it didn't bite me…"
Zankou listened to Daffodill speak, smiling, while her thoughts strangled her heart.
She didn't understand what was so appealing about a rabbit—it was just a gray vermin with red eyes. Nor did she understand how a mere rabbit could make her sister look that… happy.
But for the next few months, whenever it was time to go to the backyard for punishment, Daffodill would sneak glances at that rabbit, and Zankou would watch her. Even while enduring such unimaginable pain, her sister's gaze would soften considerably, directed towards that one corner of the garden. Sometimes, Zankou considered that, perhaps, such a gentle look was not something Mother would allow to appear in her eyes.
One day, Daffodill found only the rabbit's corpse in that familiar corner. She remained silent for the rest of the day. Before night had even fallen, she locked herself in her room.
Zankou knocked for a long while before the door finally opened. Her sister's hollow gaze hung low over the floor, her soul flickering wildly. Zankou caught a trace of bitterness in her sister's expression, something she had never seen before.
She tentatively reached out and slowly drew her sister closer. She felt Daffodill hesitate for a moment, then, as if shedding all her burdens at once, leaned her face against her shoulder without resistance. When their warmth met, Zankou sighed. Deep down, she was relieved that the rabbit had died.
"She might, perhaps, suspect that I was the one who did it."
On many nights after her sister fled, Zankou often thought of that dead rabbit.
But Daffodill never brought the matter up again.
Zankou never felt regret. She knew that the end of their road could only end in one way: death. When either one of them reached their final moments, using their final breath as a farewell might not… be so bad.
"Sister, I really didn't kill that rabbit."

Content.SourceString:
残虹和达芙蒂尔曾经是「红字」最锋利的两把刀。她们共同浸染的罪恶，与彼此心底的空洞等长。
一次接一次试炼，一个接一个任务，她们为母亲清扫障碍，成为于母亲而言越来越顺手的两把刀。残虹并不在意成为一把刀，她只是在每一个间隙长久地注视着达芙蒂尔。
作为一把刀，她熟悉母亲每一个需要被扫除的障碍。可作为一个人，她只熟悉达芙蒂尔。
达芙蒂尔总在执行完任务后对着镜子一边沉思，一边包扎伤口。而每一次，残虹都会默默地享受这个疲惫、忧郁、遍体伤痕却仍旧美丽的背影，然后一如既往地，用她的异能和温柔的拥抱，去消解姐姐的疑虑。
终于，这份疑虑带来了它的后果。
一次任务中，在理应向目标挥刀的时机，达芙蒂尔看着求饶的目标，迟迟没有斩下。残虹看见她的手在颤抖，也看见那求饶之人隐藏的杀意。她萌生出了一个危险的想法。
转瞬即逝的一刻，求饶之人的暗器寒芒朝着姐姐飞去。残虹故意挡在了姐姐身前，扛下了她已有预料的一击，随后心满意足地了结了那个狡诈的敌人……
鲜血从并非要害的位置涌出，不过是可以忍耐的疼痛。残虹喘息着抬眼，看向犯下过错的姐姐。她看见达芙蒂尔握刀的手颤栗着松开，她听见急切的脚步和声音发抖的道歉。
「终于，你变得和她们一样软弱了。」
残虹注视着眼前剧烈动摇的白色火焰，在心中默念着。
她曾无数次设想着，她不再限制自己的异能，用她的眼睛去毫无保留地窥破姐姐的一切，然后将姐姐拉入只有她们二人的幻境，攻破她的心防，扭曲她的喜好，甚至操控她的记忆，让她在彻底沦为感性无趣的俗人之前，沉沦为自己的玩物。
但她竟然克制住了。
哪怕是变得柔和、动摇，这团白色的火苗依然令她着迷。她已不愿将其磨损，就像是不愿对着完美的猎物开枪的猎人，她渴望保留这份完整。
Content.LocalizedString:
Zankou and Daffodill were once Scarlet Letter's sharpest daggers. The sins that stained them were as dark as the hollowness in their heart.
Trial after trial, mission after mission, they enacted Mother's bidding. Zankou didn't care for her life as a blade; rather, she only desired to watch Daffodill.
As an assassin, she knew of every obstacle Mother needed removed. But as a person, she knew only Daffodill
Daffodill always stood before the mirror after finishing a mission, contemplating in silence as she bandaged her wounds. And every time, Zankou would quietly savor that weary, melancholic back—beautiful even when riddled with scars—and, as always, use her Esper Ability and a tender hug to dispel her sister's doubts.
Finally, those doubts bore fruit.
On one mission, when it was time to bring the blade down on a target, Daffodill listened to the target's pleas for mercy—and stilled her hand. Zankou witnessed her hand trembling, yet also noticed the bloodthirstiness shrouded in those cries for mercy. At that moment, a treacherous idea took root in her mind.
In the blink of an eye, the cold gleam of a hidden weapon flashed toward her sister. Zankou deliberately stepped in front of the blade, taking the blow. In this moment, Zankou also struck back against the assailant, killing them.
Blood poured from her wound—pain she would willingly endure. Breathing hard, Zankou gazed upwards. She saw Daffodill's trembling hand loosen around the knife, and heard hurried footsteps and an apology laden with fright.
"At last, you've become as weak as they are."
Zankou watched, enraptured by the violently wavering flame before her.
She had imagined it countless times: no longer restraining her Esper Ability, Zankou using her eyes to see through everything, then pulling her into an illusion meant only for the two of them. Twisting her likes and dislikes, manipulating her memories—until, before she could completely devolve into a sentimental, uninteresting commoner, she would become Zankou's plaything.
However, in those final moments, Zankou had relented.
Even softened and shaken, that white flame still fascinated her. She no longer desired to snuff it out.

Content.SourceString:
残虹能记起姐姐是何时变了的，也能记起那时的自己是多么信任她，多么松懈和愚蠢。
那是在一次伊南娜的拍卖会，负责看场的达芙蒂尔并没有按照规划行动，在短暂的失踪有些狼狈地回归。她捂着自己的左眼，用「事故」二字将遭遇草草带过，对于姐姐容颜受损，残虹发了很大的火，以至于后来的几次任务，她的手段都凶暴了不少。在往后的数月里，达芙蒂尔都戴着眼罩。为了宽慰姐姐，残虹也给自己定做了一副毫无作用的眼罩，当她拿出炫耀的时候，姐姐只是错愕地笑笑。
但残虹没去想过，那个眼罩下究竟包藏着什么。
那个雨夜里，她看见倒于血泊中伊南娜，还有揭下眼罩、手持利刃的异能者达芙蒂尔。母亲的鲜血将姐姐的衣襟染成刺眼的猩红。而那团火焰……那团纯粹的白色火焰已然不再，它变成了一种与以往、与所有人都不同的，残虹此生从未见过的、「高洁的颜色」。
残虹试图理解眼前的混乱。但太多疑问在她脑中冲撞。她不明白姐姐背叛的缘由，不明白姐姐的异能从何而来，更不明白那团异色的火焰究竟代表着什么。而达芙蒂尔……她只是像一个犯下了大错的孩童，惶恐地、愧疚地、不知所措地喘息着，连紧握着凶器的手都忘记松开。
姐姐沉默地逃走了，那抹亮色消失在了红字花园的篱墙之外。
残虹甚至忘了挽留，也忘了血泊中生死不明的母亲，她的一切思绪都和目光一同投往了姐姐离去的方向，良久之后，她才说出第一句话，也是她对姐姐说过无数次，但与无数次都不相同的一句话：
「多漂亮的颜色啊……」
Content.LocalizedString:
Zankou could recall when her sister changed, and how trusting, careless, and foolish she had been before.
It was at one of Inanna's auction events. Daffodill, who was in charge of security, had acted out of turn and returned after a brief disappearance looking a bit haggard. She covered her left eye and brushed the whole incident off, referring to it as an "accident." Seeing her sister's face wounded to such an extent caused Zankou to fly into a rage, so much so that in the next few missions, her methods were far more brutal than usual. For months after, Daffodill wore an eye patch. To comfort her sister, Zankou even had one made for herself—completely useless, of course—and when she took it out to show off, her sister could only respond with a startled laugh.
Zankou never once wondered what exactly that eye patch of Daffodill's was hiding.
On one rainy night, she witnessed Inanna lying in a pool of blood, and Daffodill—the Esper who had taken off her eye patch and was holding a blade. Mother's blood had stained her sister's collar a glaring crimson. And that flame… that pure white flame was entirely extinguished. It had become something utterly unlike anything before, unlike anyone else—a color of sublime purity Zankou had never perceived in her life.
Zankou attempted to make sense of the chaos before her. Too many questions crashed together in her mind. She didn't understand why her sister had betrayed them, didn't understand where her sister's Esper Ability had come from, and didn't understand what that odd flame even meant. As for Daffodill… she merely stood there, unmoving, like a child frozen in fear, strangled by shame.
Her sister fled in silence, that streak of light vanishing beyond the hedges of the Scarlet Letter Garden.
Zankou struggled to call out for her, their mother still lying off to the wayside, forgotten in a pool of blood. All Zankou's thoughts—and her gaze—incessantly followed her sister's departing figure. An unknown amount of time had passed before she finally uttered a few words, those same words she had said to her sister countless times before:
"What a beautiful color…"

Content.SourceString:
母亲没有死于姐姐的暗杀，她醒来，养好伤，仿佛无事发生一般保持着平日里的形象。残虹并不意外，虽然姐姐的刺杀技巧无比纯熟，但母亲这样的人不可能没有后手。她看起来还是那个雍容华贵的慈善家，言谈之间似乎也并不在意达芙蒂尔的叛逃。
但残虹的眼睛能看见，那细微的变化。
过去母亲的情绪总是平稳而冷漠，甚至傲慢非常，而经历了那场刺杀后，她变得多疑、焦躁，时刻都怀揣着高位者的不安……和那些庸俗无趣的任务目标如出一辙。
记忆中那座猩红的高塔已然崩塌，但残虹没那么在乎了。
她此刻唯一的欲念，就是让那个意外逃离的姐姐重新回到她的手里……
母亲仍旧会把新的「妹妹」带回家，她开始偏爱那些能为她带去虚弱与安全感的孩子，那个叫珀塞特的女孩便是如此。残虹最初只是把她当作一株新花，打算随意赏玩后丢掉。但意外的是，她发现了这个妹妹的有趣之处，早熟而油滑她有着讨人欢心的容貌和演技，而且并不会被母亲的偏爱和折磨改变心性……比起需要浇灌的花卉，她更像一株柔韧的杂草——而且，她刚安顿不久，就有了逃离红字的打算。看破伪装的残虹来了兴致，主动推荐母亲将她提拔、赐名，从此与她一起侍奉于伊南娜左右，而这位危机感十足的妹妹也察觉到了残虹的注视，只好乖乖应允，继续着自己的表演……
虽然找到了些许乐子，但这依然无法弥补姐姐的空缺。此后，残虹没能遇见任何与达芙蒂尔的灵魂相媲美的人，这让她对姐姐的思念与日俱增……
终于，在漫长的调查之后，她找到了姐姐的行踪——海特洛的一家破旧古董店，就像一个完全不适合她的寒酸花盆。
伊南娜的下个目标就在海特洛，残虹欣然接下任务，前往打探。她每天化身为各色的路人，无数次从伊波恩的门前经过，终于，她看见了那个许久未见的面孔。
她强忍着笑意，躲进暗巷，捂住胸口，心跳如同浪涛般混乱地搏动着。
「这一次，你永远也别想从我身边逃走，姐姐。」
Content.LocalizedString:
Mother survived Daffodill's attempt on her life. She woke, recovered from her injuries, and maintained her usual image as if nothing had occurred. Zankou was unsurprised. Daffodill had mastered the art of assassination, but someone like Mother was not to be trifled with. She still performed her role as that poised, luxurious philanthropist—as if entirely unphased by Daffodill's betrayal.
Zankou could see the subtle change, however.
In the past, Mother's emotions had always been stable and cold, even going so far as to be utterly arrogant. Following the assassination attempt, though, she became distrustful, constantly carrying the unease often found in those in positions of power…
The scarlet tower in her memory had already collapsed, but Zankou no longer cared about such frivolous things.
Right now, her only desire was to drag that woman who had slipped through her fingers back by the neck…
Mother brought another "Little Sister" back home, eventually. She had begun to favor the children whose vulnerability made her feel powerful in turn—and the girl named Poinsette was one of them. At first, Zankou only considered her another flower among the field. Unexpectedly, though, she discovered an interesting side to the newly introduced bud. Precocious and gifted, that little bud wouldn't let Mother's favoritism or torment transform her into a wilting flower. Instead, she became a resilient weed, seeking any way of escape from Scarlet Letter's garden. Seeing through her act, Zankou became even more curious and took the initiative to entice Mother into promoting Poinsette, so that she would serve at Inanna's side from then on. That little bud, now a weed, noticed Zankou's intentions, and could only obediently play along…
Though the song and dance between the two amused Zankou for a while, it couldn't fill the void left by Daffodill's absence. Zankou never encountered anyone whose soul could compare to hers, and thus her longing grew day by day…
At last, after a long and thorough investigation, she caught wind of Daffodil's trail—a rundown antique shop in Hethereau, a shanty utterly unfit for her.
Fortunately, Inanna's next target was also in Hethereau, so Zankou gladly undertook the mission and went to investigate. Daily, she disguised herself as various passersby, passing by Eibon's door countless times, until she had finally come upon the face she had waited so long to see.
Suppressing a smile, she slipped into a dark alley, pressed a hand to her chest, and felt her heartbeat pounding wildly like a drum.
"This time, you'll never escape from me again, Sister."

Content.SourceString: 你可以把我当成一个秘密，一袭幻影，一场独属于你的噩梦……悦纳它吧，你将甘愿沉沦其中。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm a skeleton in your closet, an illusion in your reflections, a nightmare in your dreams… Embrace me, and sink.

Content.SourceString: 事到如今，身在何处于我而言并无多少差别……
Content.LocalizedString: At this point, I don't care where I am anymore…

Content.SourceString: 如果你将来遇上了什么大人物，可以用「赤葵」这个代号试试他们的反应，说不定，你能看到一些很有趣的表情。
Content.LocalizedString: When you run into big shots, try telling them about the "Red Nightshade." You might see some faces twitch.

Content.SourceString: 在母亲的拍卖会上，我见过不少高贵的体面人，也窥视过他们隐秘的欲望——贪图财富，渴望永生，觊觎权柄，或是想要见证某个匪夷所思的奇迹……都是些虚无空泛的妄念，俗套至极，味同嚼蜡。不过，当他们逃至末路、被无解的死局掐住脖子时，那份真切的绝望，倒是有些滋味。
Content.LocalizedString: I've seen my fair share of dignified, well-mannered people at Mother's auctions. I glimpsed into their hidden desires. They covet wealth, long for immortality, hunger for power, or want to witness a miracle… Those are all but hollow delusions and tired clichés. But when they finally run out of road, with the dead end of having them by the throat, that raw despair… now that, that has some flavor to it.

Content.SourceString: 这里的气候倒是很适合养花。
Content.LocalizedString: Flowers will grow well in this weather.

Content.SourceString: 再大的雨，也无法洗清陈年的血渍。
Content.LocalizedString: No rain can ever wash away old blood stains from years ago.

Content.SourceString: 来，看着我的眼睛，你就能忘却寒冷……
Content.LocalizedString: Here. Gaze into my eyes. You won't feel cold anymore…

Content.SourceString: 早安，鉴定师……怎么，还没习惯吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning, Appraiser… What? Still getting used to this?

Content.SourceString: 还真是悠闲呐……想午休的话请自便，我不会打扰你。
Content.LocalizedString: How cozy… Take a nap if you want to. I won't bother you.

Content.SourceString: 天色已晚……你倒是很有闲心。
Content.LocalizedString: It's getting late… You're having a good time.

Content.SourceString: 只有在深夜里，人们才愿意展露自己的真容……要一起谈谈心么？鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: People only reveal their true selves late at night… Appraiser, want to have a heartfelt conversation?

Content.SourceString: 好啊，满足你的好奇心。我的爱好……品茶，饮酒，花艺，都略有涉足，但要说最中意的，应该是狩猎。我喜欢玩弄那些猎物，看着它们在幻境中挣扎，逃窜，躲进每一个自以为安全的角落，最终在退无可退的绝境里，被榨干最后一丝求生的希望……要来试试看吗？陪我当一次猎手……或者，我的猎物？
Content.LocalizedString: Sure. Let me indulge your curiosity. My hobbies are… tea, wine, and floristry. I dabble. But if I had to pick a favorite, it would be hunting. I love toying with my prey, watching them struggle in their illusions, running and hiding in corners they deem safe, until they realize they have nowhere to go and lose their last shred of will to survive… Care to give it a try? Hunt with me… or perhaps, be my prey?

Content.SourceString: ……都是些旧事，已经无关紧要了。
Content.LocalizedString: …Those are things of the past. They don't matter anymore.

Content.SourceString: 母亲心情不好的时候，总喜欢借着训练的由头体罚我们，没过多久，又会一边假惺惺地掉眼泪，一边说着「妈妈原谅你了」之类的话。这是她调教孩子的手段，但对于我们几个……达芙蒂尔就是块铁板，鞭子抽在身上连眼都不眨一下；我能看透母亲的意图，自然也不受影响；至于珀塞特……她假哭起来，演得比伊南娜还要真。看着她俩演母女情深，也算是我的一大消遣了。
Content.LocalizedString: When Mother was in a bad mood, she loved to use "training" as an excuse to punish us physically. After she punished us, she'd start crying those fake tears while saying things like "Mother forgives you." That was her way of raising us. But for the four of us… Daffodill was made of iron. The whip could come down on her and she wouldn't even blink. I could see straight through Mother's intentions, so of course I wasn't affected. As for Poinsette… her fake tears were more convincing than Inanna's. Watching the two of them put on their mother-and-daughter act was one of my favorite ways to pass the time.

Content.SourceString: 这世界并非只有光鲜的一面，在那些隐秘的角落里，还有许多刀口舔血的家伙，为一件珍宝，一个异象，或是某个异能者，彼此争斗不休，弱肉强食。而伊南娜……在被傲慢冲昏头脑之前，她算是个手段高明、思维缜密的野心家，「红字」的财富和盛名都是由她经营而来。我和姐姐所做的，就是处理她的对手……当然，大多也是她的同类。
Content.LocalizedString: The world isn't all sunshine and rainbows. In its dark corners, plenty make their living off the edge of a blade, preying on the weak and endlessly fighting each other for treasure, anomalies, or some Esper. As for Inanna… before arrogance clouded her judgment, she was shrewd, calculating, and ambitious. She accrued all the wealth of infamy for the Scarlet Letter. Daffodill and I were responsible for dealing with her rivals… who, of course, were mostly the same type of person she was.

Content.SourceString: 这把刀名为「缚命」，也是母亲的藏品之一，那些活物般的布幔便是由它而生的。当年，在一众无趣的武器里，唯有它的刀身颜色好看，我便挑中了它。那时姐姐很喜欢保养武器，她第一次见我的刀时，以为是刀身染了血，还好心要教我如何磨洗养护……可惜，这把刀的底色本就猩红，如何洗刷都不会改变。
Content.LocalizedString: This blade is called Fatebinder. It's another one of Mother's collections. It creates those living, cloth-like drapes. Back then, I picked this blade because it caught my eye out of a pile of dull weapons. At that time, Daffodill loved maintaining weapons. The first time she saw mine, she thought the blade was stained with blood and offered to teach me how to polish and care for it… Shame, the blade was bloodred to begin with. No amount of scrubbing could ever change that.

Content.SourceString: 这只眼睛名为「惑乱」，可以嗅探情绪，扰乱心神，蚕食人的理性，使其冲动，脆弱，卷入情绪的漩涡；只要做些准备，也可捏造幻象，甚至可以置人于幻境之中。至于代价……每当我使用异能之后，它就会感到亢奋，饥渴，需要他人的负面情绪来滋养。对了，如果与我对视太久的话，可能被磨损心智，最后变成任我驱使的玩物……好了，别躲了，只是玩笑而已。
Content.LocalizedString: This eye is called "The Eye of Delusion." It can detect emotions, confuse minds, and erode one's reason, making them impulsive, fragile, and fall in a whirlpool of feelings. With a little preparation, it can also create illusions and even trap people inside. As for the price… every time I use my Esper Ability, the eye grows restless, with a hunger to feed on negative emotions from others. Oh, and if you meet my gaze for too long, your mind might get worn down, until you end up a plaything I can command however I please… Alright, don't turn away. That's just a joke.

Content.SourceString: 在我最早的记忆里，世间本只有黑白两种颜色；异能觉醒之后，第三种色彩弥补了空缺——它藏在人们灰色的皮囊之中，有时刺眼，有时污浊，但总是鲜活、温热……你的眉头又皱起来了。真想亲眼看看，在你这幅毫无破绽的面容之下，会是怎样的颜色呢……鉴定师？
Content.LocalizedString: In my earliest memories, the world only ever had two colors: black and white. When my powers awoke, a third color filled the void. It hid beneath gray skins. It was sometimes blinding, sometimes murky, but always vivid, always warm… You're frowning again. Do you think I'll ever be able to see the color on that flawless face of yours, Appraiser…?

Content.SourceString: 我偶尔会化用他人的容貌，在人群中观察这座城市……它过于包容和散漫，以至于几乎每个在此落脚的人，都自以为找到了心之所属，甚至，某些人可以为了保护这份归属感，将自己的真相抛弃、遗忘……鉴定师，你会不会也是其中之一呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes I disguise myself as someone else, then I walk through the crowds to observe this city… It's so accepting, so unfocused, that almost everyone who settles here convinces themselves they've found where they belong. Some even end up throwing away their own truth, forgetting it, just to protect that sense of belonging… Appraiser, are you one of them?

Content.SourceString: 她有着很纯粹的灵魂，像一株稳定燃烧的、洁白的火焰，哪怕身陷腥风血雨，也从不动摇。结为搭档，相处数年，我无法从她身上品尝到任何负面情绪。直到一天，在求饶的敌人面前，她犹豫了；在夜里，素来无话的她竟主动向我倾诉起来。我以为是她变得软弱了，一边遗憾着，一边期待她更加依赖我……然后，她就背叛了我们。我永远忘不了那天的暴雨，她逃走前的神情，还有她灵魂中燃烧着的……那个我从未见过的颜色。
Content.LocalizedString: She has a pure soul, like a steady white flame that never burns out even in the midst of blood and violence. We were partners for years, and I never tasted a negative emotion from her. Then one day, standing over an enemy who was pleading, she hesitated. That night, the girl who never spoke about anything came to me for a talk. I thought she was growing weak, and while I was concerned for her change, another part of me wanted her to rely on me more… Then came the betrayal. I'll never forget the storm that day, the look on her face as she escaped, and the color burning in her soul… A color I'd never seen before.

Content.SourceString: 伊南娜收养了许多孩子，但她并不怜爱我们，只是根据她的计算，把我们划分作工具，藏品，甚至交易的筹码。我？自然是用来铲除阻碍的工具了，而且是她用着最放心的那一件……虽然她傲慢得可笑，但相处多年，她给了我归处，还让我拥有了真正的家人……我会怀念她的，尤其是她临死前的样子。
Content.LocalizedString: Inanna adopted many children, but she never cared for us. She simply sorted us into tools, collectibles, or bargaining chips depending on her needs. Me? I was a tool for removing obstacles, the one she trusted most at that… Her arrogance was laughable, but after all those years, she gave me a place to belong, and she let me have a real family… I still miss her, especially the way she looked before she gave up her last breath.

Content.SourceString: 也是没想到，一个寒酸破落的古董店里，竟然藏着一位大人物。「时间的魔女」……呵，也难怪，能把「红字」的头号杀手养成现在这副软弱的模样，想必也不是一般人物……但你放心，我对你们亲爱的店长没有兴趣，也不会来打扰你们和姐姐的过家家游戏。
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't expect a shabby, run-down antique shop to harbor such a big shot—the Witch of Time… Heh, no wonder the Scarlet Letter's top assassin became a softie. That witch can't be an ordinary person… But don't worry, I have no interest in your dear shopkeeper, and I'm not going to interrupt you playing house with my sister.

Content.SourceString: 那个小家伙很有意思，明明没有读取情绪的异能，却总能逢迎母亲的喜怒，也难怪母亲总把她拴在身边。她很怕我，有时，我会故意吓一吓她，看她绷着乖巧谄媚的笑容，小脑袋瓜里却一边恐慌着、一边飞速思考该怎么回应，像一只在活板迷宫里流窜的小老鼠……按伊南娜的安排，她本该死在你的手里，最后却被你救了，按她的性子，恐怕已经对你感恩戴德了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Pointy is interesting. She doesn't have any powers to read emotions, yet she could always play along with Mother's shifting moods. No wonder Mother kept her close at all times. She was afraid of me. Sometimes I would intentionally scare her, just to watch her put on that fawning smile while her little mind was panicking, scrambling to respond, like a tiny mouse running through a maze… According to Inanna's plan, she was supposed to die by your hand, but you ended up saving her. Knowing her, she must firmly believe that she owes you her life.

Content.SourceString: 你的身上藏着许多秘密。我能品尝到你可口的情绪，却看不透你的灵魂，它仿佛是阴燃的火，不见烈焰，但灼热非凡……哪怕在异能者之中，你也是个卓越的异类，这也意味着，你其实不需要听从异象管理局的规训。他们向来无法接受脱离掌控的事物，总有一天，他们会对你恐惧、提防、约束……而我永远愿意为你松绑，也永远悦纳你的一切，你的本性，爱憎，甚至是此刻的怒火……我都甘之如饴。
Content.LocalizedString: You have many secrets, and I can taste your scrumptious emotions. Yet, I can't see through your soul. It's like a smoldering fire, no visible flame, yet burning like nothing else… Even among Espers, you stand out as an exception. This also means you don't actually need to obey the Bureau's rules. They've never been able to accept things they can't control. One day, they'll fear you, guard against you, try to limit you… But I'll always be willing to loosen your bonds, and I'll always accept everything about you. Your true nature, your loves and hates, even the anger burning in you right now… all of it is sweet to me.

Content.SourceString: 在「红字」，伊南娜会挑出一些资质较好的孩子，进行堪称折磨的「试炼」，能熬过去的孩子屈指可数，其中的少数佼佼者，会被她赐予花名，委以重任……「水仙」达芙蒂尔，「赤葵」残虹——在伊南娜的生意场里，这两个代号曾让许多人闻风丧胆。噢，珀塞特也有赐名——「一品红」，但她不像是能熬过「试炼」的样子，估计是当时耍了什么小聪明吧。
Content.LocalizedString: When I was in the Scarlet Letter, Inanna would select children with the best potential and put them through "trials" that were nothing but torture. Only a handful of kids survived. Of the few standouts, she would give them important tasks as well as flower names… Such as "Daffodil" and "Red Nightshade." In Inanna's operations, those two code names once struck fear into the hearts of many. Oh, Poinsette had a flower name too, "Poinsettia." But she didn't seem like the type who could survive the trials. I guess she pulled some clever tricks to get through.

Content.SourceString: 这股亢奋的冲动……还真是久违了。
Content.LocalizedString: This surge of excitement… It's been a while.

Content.SourceString: 它还在渴求更多，它注定永无餍足……
Content.LocalizedString: It hungers for more and cannot be satiated…

Content.SourceString: ……你做了一个危险的决定，而我会奉陪到底。
Content.LocalizedString: You made a dangerous decision, and I'm all for it.

Content.SourceString: 哼……你到底在打什么主意，鉴定师？
Content.LocalizedString: Hmph… Appraiser, what are your intentions?

Content.SourceString: 我真是越来越看不懂你了……但不论如何，多谢款待。
Content.LocalizedString: I can't figure you out anymore… Still, thank you for the gift.

Content.SourceString: 比起这个……我更希望你说说你身上的秘密，那才是我最想要的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: Instead of a gift, I'd rather you tell me a secret. That's what I really want.

Content.SourceString: 如果是需要我解决麻烦，没这个必要。
Content.LocalizedString: If you need me to solve a problem, just ask.
I bestow upon you this blessing.
Bloom for me! Wither for me!
The party has come. Dance with me!

Content.SourceString: 回收结束，下一步做什么？
我还是更习惯人形的目标。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm more used to humanoid targets.
Take this. I don't need it.
Happy now? Or is that not enough?

Content.SourceString: 你之前可不止这点能耐……
看来你荒废了不少，姐姐。
Content.LocalizedString: Sister, you have slacked in your training.

Content.SourceString: 时间的魔女，也会走到尽头吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Even the Witch runs out of time?
